comparison.objective: Load and operate a hand riveter to join two strips, dispose of the stem, and return the tool; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Rivet loading, hole insertion, square tool holding, repeated handle pumping, and debris handling versus opposed rotational control of a screw and jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a correctly set rivet without tilt/lift failure, stem in tray, and riveter returned; candidate requires retained angle and repeated gripper motion with low drift.
comparison.reason: Both use tools and require reaction control, but rivet setting permanently joins sheets and does not test a coupled adjustable setting preserved during locking.
